allowedSourceMaterial.overview: An eccentric scientist in the Amazon jungle rejects his research assistant for being a woman, but as bulldozers threaten their work on a potential cancer cure, they learn to collaborate and begin to fall in love.

facts.title: Medicine Man

semanticBoundaryFlags.message: Only one grounded mood could be established from the overview; adventure and suspense elements are present but too thinly described to tag confidently.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can two clashing researchers unlock a life-saving medical secret before approaching machinery tears down the rainforest canopy around them?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Deep in the Amazon, an eccentric scientist rejects his new female research assistant, but the pair must set friction aside when approaching bulldozers jeopardize their search for a breakthrough cancer cure.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: An earnest, medium-paced romantic adventure with moderate emotional weight and steady visual atmosphere, built for engaged date-night viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director John McTiernan pairs remote jungle adventure with romantic drama, turning a fraught medical race into an engaging two-hander charged with high environmental stakes.
